advisories.summary: Schedules Helicon on Mainnet for September 22, 2026 at 15:00 UTC. The plugin version becomes 46. C-Chain state sync can stall across activation, and several C-Chain APIs and config options stop working after it.
advisories.action: Upgrade before the Helicon time and update plugins to version 46. Do not state sync across activation. On Mainnet and Fuji, set commit-interval to 4096. Replace eth-apis with apis. A Firewood node must set state-sync-enabled to false.

advisories.summary: Backwards compatible with v1.15.0. Optional. The plugin version stays 46.
